{"metadata":{"description":"Subagent-shaped bridge between Codex and DeepSeek Harness: Codex spawns DSH workers over a loopback MCP endpoint and gets final answers back; DSH agents can dispatch to Codex in return.","id":"gh:1429840547","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-subagent-bridge","slug":"Dogtiti/dsh-subagent-bridge","topics":["codex","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","mcp","subagent"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Subagent-shaped bridge between Codex and DeepSeek Harness: Codex spawns DSH workers over a loopback "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"MCP endpoint and gets final answers back; DSH agents can dispatch to Codex in return."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-subagent-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Let Codex or Claude Code drive DeepSeek Harness sessions as subagents — and let DSH drive them bac"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"Let Codex or Claude Code drive DeepSeek Harness sessions as subagents — and let DSH drive them back."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin runs inside the Harness host and exposes a loopback MCP endpoint. It uses public host ser"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"vices (`sessionController`, `sessions`, `workspaceRegistry`, `userQuestions`) — no credential files,"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"roller`, `sessions`, `workspaceRegistry`, `userQuestions`) — no credential files, no cookie forgery."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **One tool call, one answer.** `dsh_task` opens a session, delivers the message, blocks until the "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"turn ends, and returns only the final assistant text.
- **Parallel workers.** `dsh_spawn` returns im"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"mediately; `dsh_wait` blocks until any of them settles.
- **Per-call model and project.** Pin a work"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"er to `provider/model` and file it under a named workspace without touching profile defaults.
- **Qu"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"eue or steer.** Choose whether a follow-up waits for the running turn or is inserted into it.
- **Un"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"attended by default.** Workers are told to assume a reasonable default instead of stopping to ask.
-"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" **Reverse direction.** `codex_dispatch` and `claude_dispatch` hand work to Codex or Claude Code, wi"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"th resumable threads.
- **Loop guard.** Depth and rate limits stop the two agents from delegating to"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" each other in circles."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `^0.2.1-0`.
- Codex CLI (`codex`) and/or Claude Code CLI (`claude`) on `PATH` for"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" the reverse direction."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Open **Plugins → Add** in DSH and pick that directory. On start the plugin listens on `127.0.0.1:478"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"21` and writes the endpoint file:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`~/.dsh/bridge/endpoint.json`, directory `0700`, file `0600`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Connect"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Codex"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The desktop app and the CLI share `~/.codex/config.toml`, so both see it. The token lives in the URL"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" path, so no environment variable is needed — the desktop app cannot receive custom ones when launch"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ed from Finder. `Authorization: Bearer <token>` works too."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Claude Code"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `dsh_task` | Synchronous dispatch: create session, deliver, block to end of turn, return the final"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" answer, plus `operationId`, `requestId`, `usage` and the model the worker actually used |
| `dsh_sp"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"awn` | Asynchronous dispatch: returns `task_name` + `sessionId` immediately |
| `dsh_followup` | Ano"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ther round on an existing worker, reusing its context |
| `dsh_wait` | Wait on several workers at on"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ce; returns when any reaches a terminal state |
| `dsh_close` | Close a worker and free its slot (th"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"e session stays) |
| `dsh_answer` | Answer a worker's question (limited — see below) |
| `dsh_list_w"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"orkers` | List workers started by this bridge and their live status |
| `dsh_dispatch` | Deliver one"},{"id":"p25s8","text":" message to any session; returns `requestId` and `seqAtDispatch` |
| `dsh_read_result` | Long-poll t"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"he assistant text produced after `seqAtDispatch` |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | List session metadata onl"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"y (id, title, cwd, running, last activity) |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`dsh_list_sessions` never returns message content, and `dsh_read_result` only works for sessions thi"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s bridge has dispatched to."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Model"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- `provider/model`; a bare model id keeps the current default provider.
- `reasoningEffort` is optio"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nal and model-dependent.
- Omitted means the session is untouched.
- The switch happens before the f"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"irst prompt, so the worker's first turn already runs on it, and the profile default model is not mod"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"rompt, so the worker's first turn already runs on it, and the profile default model is not modified."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Workspace"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"DSH groups sessions into projects; a new session lands under "Ungrouped" unless its directory is alr"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ions into projects; a new session lands under "Ungrouped" unless its directory is already a project."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Missing directories are created first (registration requires an existing directory). An existing pro"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ject is reused without retitling. The result carries `workspace: { id, title, path }`. A failure her"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"e never fails the dispatch."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Queue or steer"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"DSH's "sending while busy" has exactly two behaviours:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `mode` | Behaviour |"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"| `queue` (default) | Wait for the current turn, then deliver as a new turn |
| `steer` | Insert int"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"o the current turn; the model sees it at the next step |"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Two measured facts:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"1. **`steer` does not interrupt a running tool call.** A worker inside `sleep 90` only sees the mess"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"age when that call returns (70s in our test). Stopping it is the UI's cancel action, not a delivery "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"mode.
2. **`steer` does not open a new turn** — the turn number stays the same, so the bridge waits "},{"id":"p40s4","text":"for the *current* turn to end. Waiting for the next one blocks until the timeout."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"`dsh_task` refuses a running session unless `mode: "steer"` is given, and the error message says so."},{"id":"p41s2","text":" A steered reply shares the turn with the original task, so the bridge anchors the answer on its own"},{"id":"p41s3","text":" user message rather than the turn's last assistant text."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"### Unattended workers"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"A worker that calls `ask_user_question` waits for a human. When the caller is another agent, nobody "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"is there. So the bridge appends a standing instruction to every delegated task:"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"The protocol is a stateless subset of streamable HTTP: each POST returns one `application/json` body"},{"id":"p48s2","text":" and nothing is pushed, so results are collected by long polling. The server stops waiting the momen"},{"id":"p48s3","text":"t the client disconnects."},{"id":"p49s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"- DSH `^0.2.1-0` (`engines.dsh`).
- MCP protocol versions `2025-06-18`, `2025-03-26`, `2024-11-05`; "},{"id":"p50s2","text":"unknown versions fall back to the newest.
- Requires the public services `sessionController`, `sessi"},{"id":"p50s3","text":"ons`, `workspaceRegistry`, `userQuestions`. Missing ones surface as explicit tool errors."}],"truncated":true}
